purpose: Review the reader-facing coherence of the first-use path without adding onboarding automation, a product UI, or new governance authority.

review_scope.reader: A first-time adopter who follows the repository entry points before using deeper framework material.
not_checked: link completeness across the entire repository
new onboarding UI or mandatory ceremony
runtime, policy, schema, collector, scanner, dashboard or enforcement behavior

findings.finding: The deep-dive, adoption, handoff, runtime-fit, canonical-definition and release-framing paths used pre-move document locations that no longer resolve.
findings.resolution: Correct the README paths to the existing guides, concepts, contracts, reference and roadmap locations.
findings.evidence: All corrected targets exist locally; the first-use guide and core operating path remain unchanged.

findings.finding: The Unreleased section is a chronological release-history surface, not a replacement for the first-use path or current backlog state.
findings.resolution: No changelog rewrite in this slice; keep README entry points and SYSTEM_STATE/backlog as the current-operating sources.
findings.evidence: README identifies the changelog as release framing, while SYSTEM_STATE identifies the current active and deferred posture.

decision.next_step_after_closure: Reassess the integrated backlog from the documented baseline; future S28/S29 use still waits for a real qualifying Work Slice.
